usage: arb-engine kalshi [-h] [--ticker TICKER] [--side-action {buy,sell}] [--side {yes,no}]
                         [--count COUNT] [--price PRICE] [--post-only] [--confirm]
                         {balance,positions,orders,order}

positional arguments:
  {balance,positions,orders,order}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ticker TICKER
  --side-action {buy,sell}
  --side {yes,no}
  --count COUNT
  --price PRICE         price of the chosen side in dollars, e.g. 0.52
  --post-only
  --confirm             actually submit (otherwise dry-run)
